Slop Signature · Live

Email signature generator

An email signature for Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Signature has these main features: Name, title, company, phone, email, website, address and social links; Four templates, your colour and font, a logo or photo.

What you can do with Slop Signature

  • Make a Gmail signature
  • Make an Outlook email signature
  • Make an Apple Mail signature
  • Make an HTML email signature
  • A free WiseStamp alternative, in your browser
